+title: 'git: get the tree-sitter grammars from FoundationModelsCodeContext; do not link a second copy'
+---
+## What
+The git semantic diff links its own copy of SwiftTreeSitter, the tree-sitter runtime, and 14 grammar packages, plus local copies of the JavaScript and Python 0.25 grammars. FoundationModelsCodeContext already links the same grammars. Two sets of pins went out of step (tree-sitter-swift 0.7.3 against 0.7.4), and the ACP agent, which depends on both packages, could not resolve its graph.
+
+The user decision: CodeContext is the only package that links tree-sitter. Multitool gets every grammar from CodeContext.
+
+## Blocked by
+The CodeContext session adds Ruby and Elixir LanguageModules, moves JavaScript and Python to 0.25.0 (with the local C targets from Multitool), and pushes main. Do not start until it sends its main sha.
+
+## Do
+- [ ] Add `FoundationModelsCodeContext` to Package.swift through `swissArmyHammerPackage(name:)` (branch main).
+- [ ] In `CodeLanguageConfig` and `CodeParserPlugin`, get each `Language` from the CodeContext `LanguageModule.treeSitterLanguage`.
+- [ ] Remove from Package.swift: SwiftTreeSitter, the tree-sitter runtime, every grammar package, `codeParserProducts`, and the local `TreeSitterJavaScript` and `TreeSitterPython` targets.
+- [ ] Remove `Sources/TreeSitterJavaScript` and `Sources/TreeSitterPython`.
+- [ ] Update git.md (decisions 10 and 12) and eventplan.md (the 2026-08-11 decision is about diagnostics only; grammars now come from CodeContext).
+- [ ] Run `swift package update`, then the full suite. Every semantic golden must stay green.
+
+## Acceptance
+- `rg -i 'tree-sitter|SwiftTreeSitter' Package.swift` finds only the CodeContext entry and comments.
+- The full suite is green.
+- An ACP agent graph with Multitool main and CodeContext main resolves. #git
\ No newline at end of file
